name: notifications-support-route-truth
objective: Close Captain notifications, push endpoint lifecycle, deep-link actions, assigned-order support/chat and route truth while removing fabricated or contradictory live presentation.
truthOwner: DSH owns Captain notification/support state; push transport and UI routes are delivery/presentation layers only.

tasks.objective: Close Captain push endpoint and notification action lifecycle
tasks.currentProblem: Token/device/session races can leave stale endpoints or open actions after Captain authorization ends.
tasks.requiredChange: Test register/rotate/re-register/logout/unmount/revocation, permission denial, provider failure and endpoint actor isolation; validate action URL allowlist plus session/route authorization before opening Captain targets; expose delivery audit only to authorized operators.
tasks.targetState: Push endpoints and actions are device/session/actor bounded and recover without cross-Captain delivery.
tasks.action: Trace device endpoint persistence and backend ownership, fix races and authorization, test logout/token rotation/deep links and operator audit.
mustNotChange: No stale endpoint across ended session.
No operator audit exposed to Captain.
acceptanceCriteria: Actions open only safe authorized Captain routes.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused notification changes without restoring stale endpoint or unsafe deep-link behavior.

tasks.objective: Converge support/chat routes and remove fabricated live truth
tasks.currentProblem: orderchat registry/runtime behavior conflicts and reachable support surfaces may contain static Captain/order/COD/tier data.
tasks.requiredChange: Perform route/caller/deep-link census for orderchat, chat-read-ack, chat-send and support screens; converge live entries on assigned-order support, remove dead legacy branches/types/copy, replace reachable static operational/financial values with canonical APIs, and ensure Captain cannot see internal notes/rescue controls.
tasks.targetState: One truthful assigned-order support/chat experience exists with no disabled-live contradiction or fabricated data.
tasks.action: Prove reachability, migrate live callers to the canonical conversation/support APIs, delete dead paths and static truth, then run route/actor tests.
mustNotChange: No static Captain/order/COD/tier truth on reachable screen.
No internal operator notes/rescue authority exposed.
acceptanceCriteria: Dead aliases/types/copy are removed after proof.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused support convergence without restoring fabricated or contradictory live paths.
